risks.title: Impact of tariffs on margins
risks.score_rationale: Impact quantified at 275M$ on gross margin in 2025, with 216M$ offset by IEEPA tariff remittances. Elimination of de minimis exemption significantly affects e-commerce logistics from Canada. Company acknowledges mitigation measures will not fully offset these costs in 2026. This impact represents a major decline in gross margin (260 bps) and operating margin (380 bps).

risks.title: Foreign exchange translation risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk discussed in context of FX fluctuations on financial statements. Comparable sales in China and Rest of World are adjusted for constant dollars, showing non-negligible FX impact. Stable relative to prior year.

risks.title: Variable interest rate exposure
risks.score_rationale: 600M$ revolving credit facility has no significant outstanding borrowings (only 6.4M$ in letters of credit). Risk is limited in current rate environment. Stable.

risks.title: Inventory obsolescence provisions
risks.score_rationale: Inventory increased 18% to 1.7B$ in February 2026. Company explicitly links this risk to consumer demand and competition. With 3% decline in Americas comparable sales and tariff pressures, impairment risk has increased. Company expects mid-range increase by end of 2026.

risks.title: North America revenue decline
risks.score_rationale: Americas revenue down 1% with comparable sales down 3%, reflecting decline in conversion rate, store traffic, and average order value. Company has acknowledged this decline and developed structured action plan. Risk trend: increasing.

risks.title: Long-term lease commitments
risks.score_rationale: Company has significant lease commitments not included in balance sheet debt. With opening of 44 new stores in 2025 (11% square footage increase), these commitments are rising. Total amount not specified in provided excerpts but remains a factor in financial rigidity.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K.
